# postgres:18-alpine / 18 が求める位置（/var/lib/postgresql）に bind mount を置いた場合（#485）
# 上流は image（docker-library/postgres）。container CLI 1.2.2 / 2026-08-23
# 案内が指す形——起動し、ホスト側に 18/ が作られる
$ cat compose.yaml
services:
  s:
    image: postgres:18-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: x
    volumes:
      - ./data:/var/lib/postgresql
$ opossum up --no-supervisor
Creating network pg18-bind-newdir-net
Starting s (postgres:18-alpine)
s.pg18-bind-newdir.opossum
$ opossum ps | tail -1   # 見出し行は落としている
s        s.pg18-bind-newdir.opossum  postgres:18-alpine  192.168.64.2  -      running
$ ls -l data
total 0
drwxr-xr-x  3 <user>  staff  96 Aug 23 05:14 18
$ opossum logs s | tail -3
2026-08-22 20:14:47.555 UTC [1] LOG:  listening on Unix socket "/var/run/postgresql/.s.PGSQL.5432"
2026-08-22 20:14:47.560 UTC [61] LOG:  database system was shut down at 2026-08-22 20:14:47 UTC
2026-08-22 20:14:47.564 UTC [1] LOG:  database system is ready to accept connections
